bagPolicy.summary: Small bags like fanny packs, purses and small shoulder bags are fine and don't need to be clear. Backpacks, duffel bags and other large bags aren't allowed, and every bag is searched at the door.
bagPolicy.quote: Large bags like backpacks and duffle bags are prohibited, and all bags will be searched upon entry.

parking.summary: Reserve parking ahead on SpotHero, or try Wharf Garage 1 at 700 Water St SW. Metro is an easy option too: L'Enfant Plaza and Waterfront stations are within walking distance, and Capital Bikeshare docks line The Wharf.
parking.quote: We recommend booking convenient and affordable parking in advance through SpotHero,

rideshare.summary: Concerto couldn't find a rideshare pickup zone published by Union Stage. Set your pickup to the venue's address. After the show, use any signed pickup area, or walk a block or two from the main exit before you request a ride so your driver can reach you.

concessions.summary: You can eat and drink during the show, but outside food and drinks aren't allowed. Cards, Apple Pay and cash are all accepted.
concessions.quote: We accept cards, Apple Pay, and cash.

accessibility.summary: Union Stage is ADA accessible. If you need help at a show, contact the club's general manager listed on the Contact page ahead of time, or email us@unionstage.com.

reEntry.summary: Union Stage hasn't published re-entry details on its official site. Check your event page or contact the venue before you go.

ticketPickup.summary: The box office is at Pearl Street Warehouse, 33 Pearl St SW, open Monday through Friday from 12 PM to 6 PM. Staff can look up your ticket by the purchaser's name if you bring a valid photo ID. Bring a valid, non-expired government photo ID to every show; photos of IDs and student IDs aren't accepted.
ticketPickup.quote: Our box office is located at Pearl Street Warehouse (33 Pearl St SW, Washington, DC).

gates.summary: Door and show times change from show to show, so check the Shows page on the day of the show. Entry is first come, first served.
gates.quote: Door and showtimes are listed on the Shows page and they vary from show to show.
